description: Independent content event consumption, dual-version article projection, durable index task worker with Elasticsearch external conditional versioning, and bounded search cache invalidation for knode-search.

storage.engine: Dedicated independent MySQL 8 / InnoDB database for 05-search
storage.timezone: UTC (all *_ms columns store UTC epoch milliseconds)

tables.search_event_inbox: Primary key event_id (immutable business deduplication); records APPLIED, STALE_IGNORED, or IGNORED (valid non-search events such as CommentCreated/CommentReplied v1).
tables.search_event_failure: Primary key failure_key ('event:' + validEventId or 'stream:' + streamRecordId when eventId is absent/invalid); durably archives malformed protocol messages with fixed error_code, sanitized error_message, payload_sha256, and payload_bytes.
tables.search_article_projection: Primary key article_id; dual-version state (content_revision vs counter_revision), durable visibility/delete barrier (NONE/PUBLIC/WITHDRAWN/DELETED), and domain-local monotonic projection_revision.
tables.search_index_task: Primary key article_id; target_projection_revision, operation (UPSERT/TOMBSTONE), complete recoverable payload_json, status (PENDING/LEASED/DONE/DEAD), attempts/max_attempts, due_at_ms, lease_until_ms, claim_generation, last_error, es_applied_revision, and durable cache_invalidation_status (NONE/PENDING/DONE) compensation columns.

storage.queryIsolation: Public search path (GET /api/blog/search and GET /search) never requires or reads the consumer database. SEARCH-01 continues to build and run standalone with knode.search.consumer.enabled=false and no datasource configured.

streamTransport.fieldFormat: Single field 'event' containing raw UTF-8 JSON (max 8,000,000 UTF-8 bytes)
streamTransport.consumerGroup: knode-search-v1 (pre-provisioned by deployment or isolated test harness; never created by runtime code)
streamTransport.consumerName: Unique per instance (configurable, defaults to knode-search-<host>-<uuid8>)
streamTransport.isolation: Dedicated standalone Lettuce connection separate from search cache Redis; autoReconnect disabled with bounded connect/command timeouts and optional TLS.
streamTransport.ackOrdering: Single READ COMMITTED SQL transaction performs eventId deduplication, Inbox registration, locked dual-version projection update, and durable index task persistence. XACK executes strictly after SQL commit. SQL rollback performs zero XACK. Post-commit XACK failure leaves message pending for reclaim and idempotent Inbox deduplication. Malformed protocol messages are committed to search_event_failure before XACK so poison messages cannot block the Stream.

rules: Article v2 PUBLIC payload requires isTop ('0' or '1'); v1 treats isTop as optional.
Non-first v2 public updates of legacy rows allow null publicationFactId and publishedAt; ArticlePublished and v1 require them.
WITHDRAWN and DELETED payloads forbid body/text fields (content, title, summary, thumbnail, category, tags) and reject nested reason objects.
Envelope sourceRevision must equal payload counterRevision.
Never creates or resurrects full text in Elasticsearch, never overwrites content_revision, and never flips WITHDRAWN/DELETED back to PUBLIC.

nonSearchIgnored.behavior: Validated against preview/field bounds, recorded in search_event_inbox with status IGNORED for audit, never mutates projection or index tasks.

projectionRules.contentDimension: Advances strictly when event.sourceRevision > current.content_revision. Persists WITHDRAWN/DELETED visibility and revision as a durable delete barrier; rejects older content or delete events as STALE_IGNORED.
projectionRules.counterDimension: Advances strictly when event.counterRevision > current.counter_revision. Public article snapshots with older counterRevision preserve existing newer view_count/counter_revision. Counter events arriving before content store view_count/counter_revision without creating an ES task and merge when valid public content arrives.
projectionRules.projectionRevision: Monotonic per-article domain-local revision incremented in the same locked SQL transaction whenever an effective state transition requires ES synchronization. Always decoupled from content sourceRevision.

indexWorker.targetIndexConfig: knode.search.elasticsearch.index (same explicit 05-owned index/alias as public query path)
indexWorker.claimAndFencing: Short READ COMMITTED SQL transaction claims bounded due PENDING rows or expired LEASED rows (lease_until_ms <= now), assigning fresh lease_until_ms and monotonically incremented claim_generation. ES network I/O runs strictly outside SQL transactions. Completion, retry, and DEAD transitions conditionally require matching article_id, target_projection_revision, claim_generation, and status='LEASED'.

conflict409Handling.esVersionGreater: Classified as SUPERSEDED; newer ES state preserved and stale task completed conditionally.
conflict409Handling.esVersionEqualAndExactMatch: Verified via GET /{index}/_doc/{articleId}; classified as IDEMPOTENT_APPLIED (recovers ES-applied-but-SQL-mark-failed crash).
conflict409Handling.other409: Classified as CONFLICT_UNVERIFIED; retained as visible failure and retried with bounded exponential backoff until DEAD.

indexWorker.retryExhaustion: On reaching maxAttempts, task transitions to DEAD while preserving attempts, last_error, and full recoverable payload_json.

cacheInvalidation.mechanism: After ES write succeeds with refresh visibility (wait_for/true), worker executes O(1) INCR on knode:<env>:v1:search:epoch (zero KEYS/SCAN). Public queries capture currentEpoch before querying ES, namespace result keys with ':e<epoch>', and re-verify epoch unchanged before writing to cache so concurrent slow queries cannot write stale results into the active cache epoch.
cacheInvalidation.compensation: If Redis INCR fails, search_index_task retains cache_invalidation_status='PENDING' with bounded backoff due time and error detail; subsequent worker cycles retry INCR and conditionally mark DONE matching es_applied_revision.
